# Reichskommissariat Ukraine: setup, the Ukrainian Resistance raids, Kiev, the uprising.

# RKU scope. Once, the first day RKU exists (on_daily_RKU).
wif_rku_setup = {
	set_country_flag = wif_rku_setup
	load_focus_tree = { tree = wif_rku_focus keep_completed = no }
	add_ideas = { wif_rku_kochs_kingdom_idea wif_rku_breadbasket_idea wif_rku_untermenschen_idea }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_template = "Colonial Police" } } division_template = { name = "Colonial Police" regiments = { infantry = { x = 0 y = 0 } infantry = { x = 0 y = 1 } infantry = { x = 0 y = 2 } } } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_template = "Colonial Police Regiment" } } division_template = { name = "Colonial Police Regiment" regiments = { infantry = { x = 0 y = 0 } infantry = { x = 0 y = 1 } infantry = { x = 0 y = 2 } infantry = { x = 1 y = 0 } infantry = { x = 1 y = 1 } infantry = { x = 1 y = 2 } } } }
	set_variable = { wif_rku_terror_base = 120 }
	# The first raid comes a month in - from day one, unlike Moskowien.
	set_variable = { wif_rku_terror_days = 30 }
}

# RKU scope, from wif_rku.20: when the next raid comes.
wif_rku_schedule_raid = {
	set_variable = { wif_rku_terror_days = wif_rku_terror_base }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = wif_terror_attack_delayed } clr_country_flag = wif_terror_attack_delayed add_to_variable = { wif_rku_terror_days = 60 } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_country_flag = wif_mech_delay_50 } clr_country_flag = wif_mech_delay_50 add_to_variable = { wif_rku_terror_days = 50 } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_country_flag = wif_mech_delay_20 } clr_country_flag = wif_mech_delay_20 add_to_variable = { wif_rku_terror_days = 20 } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_country_flag = wif_terror_attack_early } clr_country_flag = wif_terror_attack_early multiply_variable = { wif_rku_terror_days = 0.45 } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_country_flag = wif_mech_early_30 } clr_country_flag = wif_mech_early_30 subtract_from_variable = { wif_rku_terror_days = 30 } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_country_flag = wif_mech_early_100 } clr_country_flag = wif_mech_early_100 subtract_from_variable = { wif_rku_terror_days = 100 } }
	clamp_variable = { var = wif_rku_terror_days min = 1 }
}

# State scope, ROOT = RKU: what a raid breaks - the railway (infrastructure) or a factory.
wif_rku_raid_damage = {
	random_list = {
		40 = {
			if = { limit = { ROOT = { has_country_flag = wif_rku_railway_watch } } damage_building = { type = infrastructure damage = 1 } }
			else = { damage_building = { type = infrastructure damage = 2 } }
			set_state_flag = { flag = wif_rku_hit_rail days = 1 }
		}
		30 = {
			if = { limit = { industrial_complex > 0 } damage_building = { type = industrial_complex damage = 1 } set_state_flag = { flag = wif_rku_hit_civ days = 1 } }
			else = { damage_building = { type = infrastructure damage = 1 } set_state_flag = { flag = wif_rku_hit_rail days = 1 } }
		}
		30 = {
			if = { limit = { arms_factory > 0 } damage_building = { type = arms_factory damage = 1 } set_state_flag = { flag = wif_rku_hit_mil days = 1 } }
			else_if = { limit = { industrial_complex > 0 } damage_building = { type = industrial_complex damage = 1 } set_state_flag = { flag = wif_rku_hit_civ days = 1 } }
			else = { damage_building = { type = infrastructure damage = 1 } set_state_flag = { flag = wif_rku_hit_rail days = 1 } }
		}
	}
}

# RKU scope: Kiev's resettlement (Cleansing Kiev -> Kiev Resettled), as Moskowien's Stabilise Moskau.
wif_rku_kiev_start = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_manpower > 9999 has_equipment = { infantry_equipment > 11999 } }
		add_manpower = -10000
		add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = infantry_equipment amount = -12000 }
		country_event = { id = wif_rku.10 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { country_exists = GER is_subject_of = GER }
		GER = { country_event = { id = wif_rku.5 } }
	}
	else = { country_event = { id = wif_rku.6 } }
}
wif_rku_kiev_done = {
	202 = { add_core_of = RKU }
	random_list = {
		25 = { 202 = { add_manpower = -1247676 } }
		25 = { 202 = { add_manpower = -1372443 } }
		25 = { 202 = { add_manpower = -1497211 } }
		25 = { 202 = { add_manpower = -1621978 } }
	}
	add_timed_idea = { idea = wif_rku_famine_idea days = 365 }
}

# RKU scope, monthly: compliance never settles. Non-core states above 35% (55% in a
# Pacification Zone) are pushed back down.
wif_rku_compliance_cap = {
	every_owned_state = {
		limit = { NOT = { is_core_of = ROOT } }
		if = {
			limit = { has_state_flag = wif_rku_zone }
			if = { limit = { compliance > 60 } add_compliance = -10 } else_if = { limit = { compliance > 55 } add_compliance = -5 }
		}
		else = {
			if = { limit = { compliance > 40 } add_compliance = -10 } else_if = { limit = { compliance > 35 } add_compliance = -5 }
		}
	}
}

# GER scope, from wif_ger_facade_recalc_rate: Extra Grain from Ukraine slows the
# Facade Economy's consumer goods rise while it lasts.
wif_ger_facade_rku_extra_grain = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = wif_ger_rku_extra_grain country_exists = RKU RKU = { is_subject_of = GER } }
		if = { limit = { RKU = { has_completed_focus = wif_rku_hunger_plan } } subtract_from_variable = { wif_ger_facade_rate = 0.0035 } }
		else = { subtract_from_variable = { wif_ger_facade_rate = 0.0025 } }
	}
}

# RKU scope: one more level of Hunger (3 tiers).
wif_rku_hunger_up = {
	if = { limit = { has_idea = wif_rku_hunger_2 } swap_ideas = { remove_idea = wif_rku_hunger_2 add_idea = wif_rku_hunger_3 } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_idea = wif_rku_hunger_1 } swap_ideas = { remove_idea = wif_rku_hunger_1 add_idea = wif_rku_hunger_2 } }
	else_if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = wif_rku_hunger_3 } } add_ideas = wif_rku_hunger_1 }
}

# State scope (a partisan-held RKU state), ROOT = RKU: the war score of each partisan.
# A partisan's score: states it holds + the city points of those it holds.
wif_ukr_count_score = {
	every_country = {
		limit = { wif_is_ukr_partisan = yes }
		set_variable = { wif_ukr_ws = 0 }
		every_controlled_state = {
			PREV = { add_to_variable = { wif_ukr_ws = 1 } }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = wif_sme_pts } PREV = { add_to_variable = { wif_ukr_ws = PREV.wif_sme_pts } } }
		}
	}
	set_variable = { global.wif_ukr_best = -1 }
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = UKR UKR = { wif_is_ukr_partisan = yes check_variable = { wif_ukr_ws > global.wif_ukr_best } } }
		set_variable = { global.wif_ukr_best = UKR.wif_ukr_ws }
		UKR = { save_global_event_target_as = wif_ukr_best }
		set_global_flag = wif_ukr_has_best
	}
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = UKS UKS = { wif_is_ukr_partisan = yes check_variable = { wif_ukr_ws > global.wif_ukr_best } } }
		set_variable = { global.wif_ukr_best = UKS.wif_ukr_ws }
		UKS = { save_global_event_target_as = wif_ukr_best }
		set_global_flag = wif_ukr_has_best
	}
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = UFS UFS = { wif_is_ukr_partisan = yes check_variable = { wif_ukr_ws > global.wif_ukr_best } } }
		set_variable = { global.wif_ukr_best = UFS.wif_ukr_ws }
		UFS = { save_global_event_target_as = wif_ukr_best }
		set_global_flag = wif_ukr_has_best
	}
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = UNS UNS = { wif_is_ukr_partisan = yes check_variable = { wif_ukr_ws > global.wif_ukr_best } } }
		set_variable = { global.wif_ukr_best = UNS.wif_ukr_ws }
		UNS = { save_global_event_target_as = wif_ukr_best }
		set_global_flag = wif_ukr_has_best
	}
}

# RKU scope (it has just capitulated). The partisans cut it up.
wif_ukr_rku_falls = {
	set_global_flag = wif_ukr_rku_fallen
	wif_ukr_count_score = yes
	every_state = {
		limit = { is_owned_by = RKU }
		if = {
			limit = { controller = { wif_is_ukr_partisan = yes } }
			CONTROLLER = { save_event_target_as = wif_ukr_taker }
			transfer_state_to = event_target:wif_ukr_taker
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { controller = { tag = SME } }
			transfer_state_to = SME
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_global_flag = wif_ukr_has_best }
			transfer_state_to = event_target:wif_ukr_best
		}
	}
	news_event = { id = wif_rku.41 days = 1 }
	wif_ukr_unify = yes
}

# Global: the partisan with the most territory calls the others.
wif_ukr_unify = {
	every_country = { limit = { wif_is_ukr_partisan = yes } set_variable = { wif_ukr_size = num_owned_states } }
	set_variable = { global.wif_ukr_top = -1 }
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = UKR UKR = { wif_is_ukr_partisan = yes check_variable = { wif_ukr_size > global.wif_ukr_top } } }
		set_variable = { global.wif_ukr_top = UKR.wif_ukr_size }
		clr_global_flag = wif_ukr_top_UKR clr_global_flag = wif_ukr_top_UKS clr_global_flag = wif_ukr_top_UFS clr_global_flag = wif_ukr_top_UNS
		set_global_flag = wif_ukr_top_UKR
		every_country = { limit = { has_country_flag = wif_ukr_leader } clr_country_flag = wif_ukr_leader }
		UKR = { set_country_flag = wif_ukr_leader save_global_event_target_as = wif_ukr_leader }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = UKS UKS = { wif_is_ukr_partisan = yes check_variable = { wif_ukr_size > global.wif_ukr_top } } }
		set_variable = { global.wif_ukr_top = UKS.wif_ukr_size }
		clr_global_flag = wif_ukr_top_UKR clr_global_flag = wif_ukr_top_UKS clr_global_flag = wif_ukr_top_UFS clr_global_flag = wif_ukr_top_UNS
		set_global_flag = wif_ukr_top_UKS
		every_country = { limit = { has_country_flag = wif_ukr_leader } clr_country_flag = wif_ukr_leader }
		UKS = { set_country_flag = wif_ukr_leader save_global_event_target_as = wif_ukr_leader }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = UFS UFS = { wif_is_ukr_partisan = yes check_variable = { wif_ukr_size > global.wif_ukr_top } } }
		set_variable = { global.wif_ukr_top = UFS.wif_ukr_size }
		clr_global_flag = wif_ukr_top_UKR clr_global_flag = wif_ukr_top_UKS clr_global_flag = wif_ukr_top_UFS clr_global_flag = wif_ukr_top_UNS
		set_global_flag = wif_ukr_top_UFS
		every_country = { limit = { has_country_flag = wif_ukr_leader } clr_country_flag = wif_ukr_leader }
		UFS = { set_country_flag = wif_ukr_leader save_global_event_target_as = wif_ukr_leader }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = UNS UNS = { wif_is_ukr_partisan = yes check_variable = { wif_ukr_size > global.wif_ukr_top } } }
		set_variable = { global.wif_ukr_top = UNS.wif_ukr_size }
		clr_global_flag = wif_ukr_top_UKR clr_global_flag = wif_ukr_top_UKS clr_global_flag = wif_ukr_top_UFS clr_global_flag = wif_ukr_top_UNS
		set_global_flag = wif_ukr_top_UNS
		every_country = { limit = { has_country_flag = wif_ukr_leader } clr_country_flag = wif_ukr_leader }
		UNS = { set_country_flag = wif_ukr_leader save_global_event_target_as = wif_ukr_leader }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { has_global_flag = wif_ukr_top_UKR has_global_flag = wif_ukr_top_UFS } }
		every_country = {
			limit = { wif_is_ukr_partisan = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_ukr_leader } }
			save_event_target_as = wif_ukr_joiner
			event_target:wif_ukr_leader = { annex_country = { target = event_target:wif_ukr_joiner transfer_troops = yes } }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = wif_ukr_top_UKS }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = UFS } UKS = { annex_country = { target = UFS transfer_troops = yes } } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = UKR } UKR = { set_country_flag = wif_ukr_refused } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = UNS } UNS = { set_country_flag = wif_ukr_refused } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = wif_ukr_top_UNS }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = UKR } UNS = { annex_country = { target = UKR transfer_troops = yes } } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = UFS } UNS = { annex_country = { target = UFS transfer_troops = yes } } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = UKS } UKS = { set_country_flag = wif_ukr_refused } }
	}
	news_event = { id = wif_rku.42 days = 2 }
}

# Partisan scope (it has capitulated to the reunited Reich): no peace deal. Its land goes
# to a re-established Reichskommissariat Ukraine.
wif_ukr_reestablish = {
	every_owned_state = { transfer_state_to = RKU }
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = RKU country_exists = GER }
		GER = {
			if = { limit = { NOT = { RKU = { is_subject_of = GER } } } puppet = RKU }
			set_autonomy = { target = RKU autonomy_state = autonomy_reichskommissariat end_wars = no end_civil_wars = no }
		}
		RKU = { country_event = { id = wif_rku.45 days = 1 } }
	}
}

# on_capitulation_immediate: ROOT capitulated, FROM the winner.
wif_ukr_on_capitulation = {
	if = {
		limit = { tag = RKU has_global_flag = wif_ukr_uprising NOT = { has_global_flag = wif_ukr_rku_fallen } any_country = { wif_is_ukr_partisan = yes } }
		wif_ukr_rku_falls = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { wif_is_ukr_partisan = yes FROM = { tag = GER } has_global_flag = wif_ger_reunified }
		wif_ukr_reestablish = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { wif_is_ukr_partisan = yes FROM = { wif_is_ukr_partisan = yes } }
		FROM = { annex_country = { target = ROOT transfer_troops = yes } }
	}
}

# RKU scope, daily.
wif_rku_daily = {
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_rku_setup } } wif_rku_setup = yes }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wif_rku_terror_days > 0 } }
		subtract_from_variable = { wif_rku_terror_days = 1 }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { wif_rku_terror_days > 0 } } } country_event = { id = wif_rku.20 hours = 6 } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_global_flag = wif_ukr_uprising }
			has_global_flag = wif_sme_war_active
			219 = { controller = { tag = SME } }
		}
		wif_ukr_uprising = yes
	}
}

# Weekly, any scope: the reunited Reich goes to war with every partisan state, and the
# auxiliaries are stabbed in the back once the partisans are gone.
wif_ukr_weekly = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = wif_ukr_uprising has_global_flag = wif_ger_reunified country_exists = GER }
		every_country = {
			limit = { wif_is_ukr_partisan = yes NOT = { has_war_with = GER } }
			save_event_target_as = wif_ukr_target
			GER = { declare_war_on = { target = event_target:wif_ukr_target type = annex_everything } }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = RKU RKU = { has_country_flag = wif_rku_aux_militia } NOT = { any_country = { wif_is_ukr_partisan = yes } } }
		RKU = {
			clr_country_flag = wif_rku_aux_militia
			delete_unit = { division_template = "Ukrainian Auxiliary Militia" }
			country_event = { id = wif_rku.46 }
		}
	}
}
